entries.name: Datalayer Jupyter MCP
requirements: Select for qualification. Prefer this maintained upstream route initially. Requires Jupyter environment and runtime access; qualify kernel lifecycle, cancellation and output handling. BSD-3-Clause upstream.
entries.description: Open/edit/execute notebook cells, inspect outputs, turn data analysis into a reproducible notebook.

entries.name: Native DSH Jupyter
requirements: Adapt later. Manifest declares Apache-2.0 but older DSH peers. Native panel is useful only after exact-host and licence-file checks. Do not bypass peers.
entries.description: Notebook workbench embedded in the harness.

entries.name: MotherDuck/DuckDB MCP
requirements: Pinned upstream source is 1.1.0 at 41acb581d9bc04e427655ba5178b2c5c01f68cd2; adapted distributable and Linux/Windows qualification remain unavailable.
Python >=3.10 and the pinned upstream dependency DuckDB 1.5.6; FastMCP >=4.0.11, Click >=8.5.0 and pytz >=2026.5 need a locked, qualified runtime distribution.
Local files default to read-only. Select the database path explicitly; in-memory mode requires explicit read-write permission. Set bounded query/output limits before qualification.
MotherDuck cloud access is a separate optional account route. No cloud token is required for the local DuckDB route.
entries.description: Query local analytical data and DuckDB databases; optional MotherDuck connection.

entries.name: Microsoft MarkItDown
requirements: Select as ingestion component. Real conversion engines and OCR should be identifiable; fallback conversion is not equivalent. MIT Microsoft project. This complements MinerU rather than replacing difficult PDF OCR/layout handling.
entries.description: Convert common document formats into readable Markdown for research and subsequent authoring.

entries.name: Excel Chat / Vera
requirements: Select for qualification. Bundle 0.40.0 declares MIT and broad peers. Core editing does not require Excel; charts/PDF export rely on Windows Excel. Formula verification claims need representative real-workbook proof.
entries.description: Read, edit and clean spreadsheets; inspect formula results and generate reports.

entries.name: Reference Checker
requirements: Select academic pack. Preserve found/partial/not-found/error states and evidence. A missing match is not proof a citation is fabricated. MIT.
entries.description: Check bibliography entries against scholarly metadata sources.

entries.name: Zotero DSH
requirements: Select reading connector. Zotero must run with local communication enabled. Upstream documents local API note writes as unavailable on tested versions; do not promise writable notes.
This route requires a profile-wide native host adapter; it cannot claim workspace-isolated MCP activation.
entries.description: Search an existing Zotero collection, inspect metadata, read local full text and attachments.

entries.name: Hugging Face MCP
requirements: Select research/model-discovery connector. Separate Hub discovery from paid inference-endpoint provisioning. Tools exposed by third-party Spaces require individual qualification.
entries.description: Discover models, datasets, research papers and selected Space tools.

entries.name: MATLAB MCP, MathWorks
requirements: Optional licensed engineering pack. Requires an installed supported MATLAB and the user's licence. Not a free MATLAB replacement or universal default.
entries.description: Run and inspect MATLAB work in engineering/scientific projects.

entries.name: Obsidian ACP bridge
requirements: Optional interoperability route. Verify ACP handshake and workspace ownership; do not create another memory store just to connect a vault.
entries.description: Use BC in an existing notes/vault workflow.

entries.name: Typst Preview
requirements: Select publishing pack. Version 0.3.8 declares MIT and peer range including BC rc.2. Requires tinymist; verify desktop preview and export.
entries.description: Edit technical reports with rendered previews.

entries.name: Oh Story
requirements: Retain and expand creative pilot. Current 0.1.14 documents BC rc.2 support and native host/model usage. English docs do not prove all UI/prompts are English; inspect them before offering. MIT.
entries.description: Long-form fiction, short drama, interactive stories, video recap workflows.

entries.name: DSH Translator
requirements: Adapt for translation pack. Version 0.2.0 declares MIT but peers `<0.2.0` exclude current BC. It handles text/plain-text files, not general PDF/DOCX/audio translation.
entries.description: Side-by-side text translation with glossary and persona choices.

entries.name: Subtitle Studio
requirements: Select alongside media tools. Default external DeepSeek route must be replaced/configured to native DSH provider mode and verified with chosen user models. MIT declaration.
entries.description: Parse, translate, merge and export SRT/VTT while retaining alignment and glossaries.

entries.name: DSH FFmpeg
requirements: Select media utility. Version 0.4.5 declares MIT; requires ffmpeg/ffprobe. Verify outputs and dependency discovery on Windows/macOS/Linux.
entries.description: Probe/cut/concatenate/transcode media, extract audio/subtitles/frames and make GIFs.

entries.name: draw.io official MCP
requirements: Select visual authoring route. Standard tool-server first. Hosted inline editor uses MCP Apps, a separate host capability that BC has not been qualified for. Complements existing visuals when editable diagram files matter.
entries.description: Create editable diagrams from Mermaid, XML or CSV.

entries.name: DeepBlend
requirements: Optional 3D pack. Requires Blender; documented baseline is DSH 0.1.5-rc.2, so BC rc.2 compatibility needs proof. MIT project declaration.
entries.description: Blender scene authoring, inspectable revisions and renders in a workbench.

entries.name: Blender MCP
requirements: Alternative to DeepBlend. Pick one primary route per pack after testing; inspect addon version, process access and optional telemetry settings.
entries.description: Connect to an existing Blender installation without needing a custom workbench.

entries.name: DSH CAD
requirements: Optional CAD pilot. Actual repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0 despite MIT README badge. Resolve package/documentation discrepancy before redistribution. Qualify real export geometry.
entries.description: Parametric models, constrained sketches, 2D/3D previews and fabrication exports.

entries.name: FreeCAD MCP
requirements: Alternative CAD connector. Requires FreeCAD and bridge setup. Prefer this for existing FreeCAD projects; avoid enabling multiple competing CAD toolsets by default.
entries.description: Operate the user's existing FreeCAD installation.

entries.name: QGIS MCP
requirements: Optional desktop GIS route. Requires QGIS and plugin bridge; exact API/environment qualification needed.
entries.description: Geospatial operations inside an existing QGIS environment.

entries.name: DSH WebGIS
requirements: Web-host pilot only. Version 0.2.0 targets rc.2, but upstream explicitly says official desktop transport unsupported. Not a general BC Desktop promise.
entries.description: Interactive maps, vector data and PostGIS workflows.

entries.name: Tylina
requirements: Hold for redistribution review. README explicitly describes proprietary core npm dependencies. Prefer open-source Typst Preview for the initial pack.
entries.description: Typst-based academic/report/slide authoring with packaged engine.

entries.name: Google Workspace MCP
requirements: Highest-value connected-work pilot. Community project, not Google official. Supports 120+ tools across twelve services and progressive tiers/read-only mode. Requires Google Cloud OAuth client/API setup; BC must make that setup understandable. MIT upstream.
entries.description: Work across Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar and other Google applications.

entries.name: Linear official MCP
requirements: Select team-work connector. Qualify Streamable HTTP/OAuth; read-only endpoint exists for initial onboarding.
entries.description: Turn discussion/research into tracked issues, projects and status updates.

entries.name: Atlassian Rovo MCP
requirements: Select alongside Linear as account choice. Requires Atlassian account/admin-compatible setup; test available scopes/tools, not assumed parity with all product APIs.
entries.description: Connect Jira/Confluence work and documentation.

entries.name: GitLab official MCP
requirements: Select GitLab alternative to GitHub. Currently beta; server access must be enabled at group/instance level. HTTP and proxy routes supported upstream.
entries.description: GitLab projects, merge requests and workflow context.

entries.name: n8n instance MCP
requirements: Optional automation pack. Requires configured n8n instance/access and workflows exposed to MCP. Do not imply every workflow or arbitrary graph edit is available.
entries.description: Discover and trigger suitable existing automations.

entries.name: WordPress official MCP adapter
requirements: Optional publishing pack. GPL-2.0-or-later adapter and site setup/authentication required. Available tools depend on registered abilities; no automatic claim of complete publishing coverage.
entries.description: Operate site capabilities registered through WordPress Abilities.

entries.name: Postiz agent integration
requirements: Optional publishing connector. Auth/account/self-host prerequisites apply. User-visible drafts and explicit publishing intent are needed for real actions.
This route requires a profile-wide native host adapter; it cannot claim workspace-isolated MCP activation.
entries.description: Prepare, schedule and publish to configured social channels.

entries.name: HubSpot MCP
requirements: Optional business pack. Distinguish CRM remote MCP from developer app-building tooling; auth app beta and account support need qualification.
entries.description: Read and update supported CRM records.

entries.name: Stripe official MCP
requirements: Optional business pack. Qualify exact tool/scoping/account behaviour; do not infer arbitrary money-transfer functionality from MCP availability.
entries.description: Work with supported Stripe account/development operations.

entries.name: Home Assistant MCP
requirements: Optional personal automation pack. Existing Home Assistant required. Streamable HTTP with OAuth or token; OAuth uses URL client metadata/IndieAuth rather than RFC7591 registration, so a generic DCR-only client fails.
entries.description: Inspect home context and control exposed devices/assist tools.

entries.name: Figma official MCP
requirements: Hold remote availability promise. Figma documentation limits remote connections to clients in its catalog. Establish BC eligibility first; desktop routes have separate prerequisites.
entries.description: Retrieve design context and supported canvas operations.

entries.name: Sentry official MCP
requirements: Select operations connector. OAuth and explicit organisation/project scope; test real trace/error access.
entries.description: Investigate application errors and performance with live project evidence.

entries.name: Cloudflare official MCP servers
requirements: Optional cloud pack. Choose service-specific capabilities; configured account and write scope required.
entries.description: Inspect or manage supported Workers, account and infrastructure services.

entries.name: AWS agent tooling / MCP
requirements: Optional cloud pack. Upstream now points to Agent Toolkit for AWS as successor; evaluate current recommended path, IAM and service costs. Do not ship every historical AWS MCP server.
entries.description: AWS diagnostics and service operations.

entries.name: Microsoft MCP
requirements: Optional cloud pack. Service-specific onboarding; this repository is not proof of a complete Microsoft 365 connector.
entries.description: Supported Azure/Microsoft developer services.

entries.name: Microsoft Playwright MCP
requirements: Select developer QA option. Distinct from casual browsing; integrate with current browser ownership and avoid two uncontrolled browser lifecycles.
entries.description: Reproducible browser interaction and application checks.

entries.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
requirements: Select developer debugging option. Useful instrumentation beyond browser clicks; requires Chrome and deliberate session attachment.
entries.description: Debug network/console/performance in Chrome.

entries.name: BrowserStack MCP
requirements: Optional paid/account QA pack. Account/product entitlement required; no universal free device-lab promise.
entries.description: Cross-browser/device testing through existing test infrastructure.

entries.name: Deque Axe MCP
requirements: Optional accessibility route. Qualify product/account entitlement; automated checks cannot establish full accessibility conformance.
entries.description: Accessibility findings and assisted fixes during frontend work.

entries.name: Codegraph
requirements: Pilot beside LSP Actions. Python/SQLite implementation with CLI and MCP-style tool server; validate actual protocol/language resolution, do not treat heuristic call edges as compiler truth.
entries.description: Local symbol search and transitive impact queries across code.

entries.name: DSH DevOps
requirements: Optional combined ops UI. Compare with official GitLab and selected Kubernetes tooling before adopting overlapping tools; kube/token dependencies. MIT declaration.
entries.description: GitLab pipelines/MRs plus Kubernetes operations in a workbench.

entries.name: DSH Kubectl
requirements: Hold for focused operations qualification. Wildcard peers prove little; explicit context and apply/delete/exec behaviour need checks.
entries.description: Execute Kubernetes operations through configured local kubectl.

entries.name: Hyzyn plugin kit
requirements: Select modules individually. Current rc.2 declarations are useful; do not install its whole toolkit by default. Apache-2.0 upstream.
entries.description: Selected Docker/RSS/screenshot/task and utility modules.

entries.name: Cloud Sync
requirements: Optional continuity pack. This is not verified whole-project sync. Gist mode explicitly syncs configuration only; qualify restore, conflicts and sensitive fields before offering. English adaptation required.
entries.description: Backup/restore supported harness configuration and optional plugin sources via selected storage backend.

entries.name: Session Search Pro
requirements: Adopt capability via native session query, adapt plugin if needed. Older peer ranges; no need for another agent memory engine. MIT.
entries.description: Find useful previous sessions.

entries.name: Lost and Found
requirements: Optional local knowledge pack. rc.2-compatible range declared; verify Windows/Linux/macOS path handling and index freshness. MIT.
entries.description: Find files across user-selected directories using local indexes.

entries.name: Daruma
requirements: Hold pending native-retry overlap review. Actual plugin 0.1.8 peers `<0.1.6` exclude current BC. User-selected fallback routes, replay boundaries and credential ownership required; no automatic model/provider substitution.
entries.description: Controlled provider failover after selected request failures.

entries.name: DSH Eval
requirements: Internal qualification candidate. Older peers; useful for proving packs before public availability, not mandatory for end users.
entries.description: Scripted workflow evaluations, traces and comparisons.

entries.name: Issue2PR
requirements: Do not default-install. Reconcile staged approval/planning with BC's native workflow before adding another orchestration layer.
entries.description: Opinionated issue-to-change pipeline.

entries.name: Data and Notebooks
requirements: Select individual qualified components.

entries.name: Academic
requirements: Select individual qualified components.

entries.name: Media
requirements: Select individual qualified components.

entries.name: Technical Publishing
requirements: Select individual qualified components.

entries.name: BC CI pipelines
entries.description: Inspect GitHub Actions and GitLab.com pipelines, read job logs, prepare fixes and request authorized reruns.
requirements: Native Windows packed-install and native approval qualification pending.
GitHub Actions read permission or GitLab.com project CI access. Real-account workflows pending.
Reruns are disabled until explicitly configured; native approval required.

entries.name: LaTeX Papers and Reports
entries.description: Use existing TeX Live or MiKTeX for LaTeX templates, equations, bibliographies and PDF output. Inspect and install the BC LaTeX starter skill in Skills Manager.
requirements: The starter skill is bundled with the standard Skills Manager. Install it explicitly in Skills Manager.
Requires an existing LaTeX engine; latexmk is recommended for repeated passes and bibliography builds. Managed TeX distribution setup is not qualified.
A version probe does not qualify compilation, project-specific classes, bibliography, fonts or native Windows PDF output.
